1. Inspect remaining relevant gameplay/runtime behavior and choose meaningful fixes.

- `src/game.js`: Main lifecycle, controls, survival loop, quests, combat, crafting, and persistence.
- `src/ui.js`: UI bindings and rendering.
- `index.html`: Game interface and module entry point.
- `styles.css`: Presentation and responsive layout.
- `src/world.js`: Procedural world and environment.
- `src/dinos.js`: Dinosaur behavior and taming.
- `src/items.js`: Item and crafting definitions.
- `start.sh`: Runtime startup script.
- `Agents.md`: Project workflow and browser verification notes.

## Important Context
- The game is titled “ARK: Survival Evolved — Primal Isle” and includes touch and keyboard controls, crafting, quests, dinosaur taming, survival stats, and local saves.
- No tests or runtime checks have been performed; repository working tree was clean at last check.
